decision.observation: Zoomed view of the latched gate. The latch hardware: a bracket on the top rail near the right post at ~(0.70, 0.47), with a curved hooked handle hanging below it at ~(0.69, 0.63) — roughly at the goose's standing beak height. The goose stands at ~(0.48, 0.65), ~250px left of the handle. Controls: grab = left mouse or Z; right mouse = zoom out (so right-clicks were only zooming).
decision.hypothesis: The hooked handle is the sliding bolt; if the goose stands beside it and left-presses exactly on it (grab) then drags left, the bolt will slide out and the gate will swing open.
decision.memory: Right-click is camera zoom-out in this game — earlier 'beak grab' right-clicks were actually zooms. Grab = left mouse/Z. Pickup confirmed as Ctrl+left.
